summary: Afya Limited filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly financial results with no special-situation transaction. Revenue for the six months was R$1.985 billion, net income R$463.1 million. No mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or strategic actions are disclosed. This is a standard periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event.
